artifact_improvement: A reviewer can now compile a deterministic RAKL task packet and execute it through a governed local adapter with immutable input/output/event receipts and replay semantics.
supportable_now: RAKL has a provider-neutral executable project/task-packet runtime
the runtime binds exact task packets and raw process outputs by SHA-256
completed identical invocations replay without re-executing the external command in the tested local model
ambiguous historical RUNNING states fail closed
generation configuration is delivered through and bound to the runner protocol without claiming provider compliance
model/adapter output remains proposal-only irrespective of zero exit status
not_supportable_yet: RAKL superiority over strong scientific-agent baselines

required: real tasks with frozen evidence cutoffs

recommended_posture: The repository is increasingly suitable as an executable method/specification artifact. A publication can describe the formal method and validated engineering invariants now, but broad scientific-performance claims must remain preregistered/open until real matched experiments are executed.
